policy.hard_exit: All scenario-category obligations explicitly selected by P0 priority slices F6-01 through F6-05 must be covered. No release-blocking obligation may remain partial, gap or na.
policy.non_blocking_rule: Every audit assessment outside the explicit F6-01 through F6-05 release-blocking obligation set remains visible in the source audit and is informational for later hardening, but is not a Phase-6 release blocker.
policy.gap_disposition_rule: Every raw gap outside the release-blocking obligation set must be explicitly enumerated below; any new or unenumerated gap fails closure.
policy.no_status_rewrite: The 43/48/26/23 source audit statuses are not rewritten to make closure green.
